days.title: コーヒーの都
days.morning: Red noodle soup for breakfast and a Ban Me coffee.
days.afternoon: World Coffee Museum and Trung Nguyen coffee village.
days.evening: Stroll the central square; grilled chicken with bamboo rice.

days.title: ドレイヌール – ドレイサップ滝
days.morning: Drive ~30 min to Dray Nur and Dray Sap falls.
days.afternoon: Visit a coffee farm and see how beans are roasted.
days.evening: Gong music and rice wine at Ko Sier village.

days.title: ラック湖
days.morning: Head to Lak Lake (~1 h) and paddle a dugout canoe.
days.afternoon: M'Nong Jun village and Bao Dai's palace.
days.evening: Sleep in a longhouse; grilled lang fish.

days.title: ブオンドン
days.morning: Buon Don suspension bridges and old stilt houses.
days.afternoon: Elephant conservation centre (choose a walking tour).
days.evening: Back in the city for lang fish hotpot.

days.title: 市場と高原のお土産
days.morning: Buon Ma Thuot market for coffee, pepper and macadamias.
days.afternoon: The old colonial prison and Khai Doan pagoda.
days.evening: Fly out or continue to Da Lat or Nha Trang.
